question.nlq: Hey! Could you help me figure out who our biggest spenders are? I'd love to grab all those customers whose total purchases went over $5000 and show me their contact details. But honestly, I'm not super sure which contact info would be most useful for us right now...

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When we say 'contact details', I actually mean their phone numbers - that's what our sales team needs to reach them for follow-ups. Not their email or mailing addresses.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT c.customer_phone
FROM Customers c
JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL) * p.product_price) > 5000

WHERE co.order_status_code = 'Completed'
GROUP BY c.customer_id
ORDER BY total_spending DESC
LIMIT 5;
